title: SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B: open robot VLM that calls a VLA policy, reviews trajectories or writes code, 34.7 on RoboDojo
summary: SenseNova released an Apache-2.0 27B vision-language model for robots that can request a motion from a VLA policy, inspect the camera result and correct its next move, or write code as policy. It averages 34.7 on RoboDojo under the same harness where its preview scored 10.0.
